Summary

  • A (shared renderings): 186 edits (Atr. 64, Gilg. XI 50, Sumerian 17, other Akkadian 38, references 17). The changes: nammaššû → הַנָּע; eṣēru → צַרְתִּי; tabāku → יצקתי; sīrāšu → סֹבֶא; nāṣirat napištim / naṣāru → נוֹצֶרֶת נֶפֶשׁ / נצר; (עליי) in the iktabta line; Sumerian שָׁטַף; הָאֻמָּנִים; ubut / upud notes; gamertu, rādu and makurru in the cross-quotations; bābu = שער; the SB speech formula (Atr. II E 133); tarkullu / nasāḫu; šār = שָׁאר; tenēšētu; manzāzu; qerbu; kibrāti; ekēlu; Sum. שחורי הראש; the רַב־תְּבוּנָה gloss; and the project-level renderings.md / project.md rows that quoted the old Hebrew.
  • B (shared lines): 18 edits. Atr. III ↔ Gilg. XI was checked pair by pair against the table in 1-אתרחסיס/project.md, and the C₀ iv lines in projects 1 and 4 were compared: all aligned. Fixed: Atr. II H 21–24 ↔ Gilg. XI 100–102 ↔ U r. 15′; and the cross-quotations in Gilg. XI 66, 67, 120, 129, 173 and in Atr. II.
  • C (niqqud): project 3 converted (107 lines in each of its two files). Elsewhere: 34 spelling fixes, a few names vocalized at first occurrence, and the plain-text form גילגמש.
  • D (Bible): 15 fixes, plus one checker bug fixed. Final run: 0 problems on all .md files of the corpus. A supplementary scratch check of reference-before-quote order (scratchpad revcheck.py) found 2 more errors, both fixed.
  • E (sync): projects 2–6 and Atr. I now match exactly (ignoring recension labels and footnote markers). The remaining Atr. II/III differences are structural only: fragment-only lines are grouped as one translation line, and the B viii colophon of Tablet II has a single label in the translation. The text is identical.

Remaining inconsistencies (not changed)

  • Atr. I têrtu (116–157, Enlil's message carried by Nusku) keeps צו. The shared row reserves הוֹדָעָה for messages brought by messengers, so these lines are borderline.
  • Recension labels: Atr. I translation writes (נוסח אשורי), Atr. II [נוסח אשורי]. Square brackets mean "restored" (guidelines §6.8), so ( ) or a different mark would be clearer. Not harmonized.
  • Project 5 writes Daisios as דיסיוס. A plene spelling of the shared דַּיְסִיּוֹס would be דייסיוס.
  • Project 6 vocalizes names once per project, not once per text (it has 9 texts). I fixed only Enlil in three texts.
  • Gilg. I 18–23 (project 6) ↔ Gilg. XI 323–328: XI 323–328 is untranslated (outside 1–208).
  • The revcheck.py scratch check matches only ref quote`` adjacency. Quotations whose reference is further away were not checked.

Objections

  1. sīrāšu / kurunnu (Gilg. XI 73). Giving סֹבֶא to sīrāšu takes the word that Gilg. XI used for kurunnu, and the shared file gives kurunnu nothing. I used סֹבֶא מובחר for kurunnu ("fine beer"). Please add a kurunnu row.
  2. tabāku = יָצַק for solids (Gilg. XI 160). attabak qanâ erēna asa: "I heaped reed, cedar and myrtle". יצקתי קנה, ארז והדס is odd Hebrew, since יָצַק is used of liquids and metal. Applied as decided. Suggest יָצַק for liquids (XI 66) and צָבַר or עָרַם for solids (XI 160), or a note.
  3. naṣāru = נָצַר vs. the formula's שְׁמֹר. The shared formula row renders šuṣṣirī (naṣāru Š, Atr. III i 21) שְׁמֹר, while §3a says naṣāru = נָצַר. I kept שמור in i 19 and i 21 (the formula), and changed vi 19 and viii 17 to נצר. This breaks the Tablet III translator's frame (שמר … שמר). One rule is needed.
  4. manzāzu outside the dove passage (Erra I 134). מקום עמידתם של כוכבי השמים is heavy. The row was made to avoid מָנוֹחַ in Gilg. XI 150, 153. Consider limiting it to that sense.
  5. kibrāti = קְצוֹת הָאָרֶץ (Gilg. XI 140, Ugarit I 3). "The earth" is not in the Akkadian. Applied without parentheses, as an idiomatic rendering of the plural. If §6.8 is meant strictly, it should be קצות (הארץ).

Coordinator follow-up (2026-10-16)

  • Objection 2 accepted: tabāku = יָצַק for liquids and צָבַר for solids. Gilg. XI 160 is now תחתיהם צברתי קנה, ארז והדס. Shared row updated.
  • Recension tags in Atra-ḫasīs I–II are now {נוסח …} in curly braces in both files (314 replacements), so they no longer clash with [ ] "restored". Added to guidelines §6.8.
  • Project 5: דיסיוס → דייסיוס (plene spelling).
  • Objections 1, 3, 4, 5: accepted as the harmonizer applied them; no further change.
